svg.aria-label: Soterra — AI Disaster Hotline (Cal Hacks 13.0). An AI-powered phone hotline delivering real-time, verified natural disaster updates over regular phone calls: no internet, mobile data, or apps required. When storms or wildfires knock out power and cell networks, anyone can dial in and get answers synthesized from official emergency feeds (USGS, NWS, IPAWS, CalFire).
